principle: Data holdings are grouped datasets, ledgers, registries or contracts with one primary Room owner. Secondary Rooms may consume them without becoming co-owners. Runtime/render/config artifacts may remain unbundled when they are implementation rather than knowledge.

bundles.title: House governance & topology data
bundles.purpose: House registries, topology, coverage, manifests, routing and repository-maintenance contracts.

bundles.title: Axis, transformation & depth contracts
bundles.purpose: Project-symbolic verticality, thresholds, D-levels, operators and transformation rules.

bundles.title: Geometry & projection calibration
bundles.purpose: Exact geometry, calibration and projection records used to separate mathematical structure from symbolic interpretation.

bundles.title: Potatoverse canon & concept data
bundles.purpose: Canonical identities, terms, project observations, thought synthesis and concept relations.

bundles.title: Potatoverse cosmology & deep architecture data
bundles.purpose: Internal cosmology and deep symbolic architecture, explicitly separate from empirical physical cosmology.

bundles.title: Potatoverse theology & interpretation data
bundles.purpose: Explicit theological interpretation and project religion records, kept distinct from historical Christian doctrine.

bundles.title: Belief, religion & comparative registries
bundles.purpose: Comparative religion, belief-space and source registries that preserve tradition distinctions.

bundles.title: Comparative cosmology data
bundles.purpose: Cross-tradition cosmology comparison around Axis-like structures without asserting identity.

bundles.title: Biblical & Christian corpus data
bundles.purpose: Biblical text, Christian corpus metadata, theological records and Bible-facing indexes.

bundles.title: Timeline & event data
bundles.purpose: Dated event records, event packs and specialist developmental/public-theology timelines.

bundles.title: Evidence & source registries
bundles.purpose: Source registries, evidence maps and provenance records used to audit claims and reconstruction.

bundles.title: Country atlas & geographic data
bundles.purpose: Ordinary geography, country entities, subdivisions, enrichment batches and measured spatial context.

bundles.title: World-system blueprints
bundles.purpose: Reusable research templates for governance, law, finance, trade, infrastructure, technology, culture, labour, security and other observable systems.

bundles.title: Economy, finance & European system data
bundles.purpose: Observed and modeled economic coupling, indicators, sectors, trade and European system relations.

bundles.title: North Programme data
bundles.purpose: Project programme evidence, geographic/system fields and relationship-oriented North research.

bundles.title: World infrastructure & dependency data
bundles.purpose: Observable infrastructure, institutional membership, dependency chains and empirical networks.

bundles.title: Politics & governance data
bundles.purpose: Political vocabulary, actors, institutions and influence structures.

bundles.title: Security & intelligence data
bundles.purpose: Security/intelligence organizations and relation graph, kept distinct from symbolic conflict language.

bundles.title: Law & accountability data
bundles.purpose: Legal/accountability seeds and human-consequence routing.

bundles.title: Culture, platforms & information ecology data
bundles.purpose: Culture, platform, underground-network and information-ecosystem records.

bundles.title: High-control, extremism & group-dynamics data
bundles.purpose: Evidence-typed high-control, extremism, harassment and symbolic Swamp research data.

bundles.title: Graph & relational-system data
bundles.purpose: Typed nodes, relationships, couplings and graph-state structures that connect the project without replacing domain ownership.

bundles.title: Research frontier & expansion data
bundles.purpose: Open questions, expansion waves, alternative directions, research roadmaps and frontier state.

bundles.title: Potato, body & symbolic anatomy data
bundles.purpose: Potato properties and explicit symbolic/psychological body crosswalks, kept separate from scientific anatomy.

bundles.title: Meaning & ontology registries
bundles.purpose: Symbolic meaning layers, ontology and framing data used by project interpretation.
